question: Should this PR retain persistent per-provider palette editing, or be narrowed to curated provider defaults only?
rationale: Both variants are technically viable, but adding a saved editor is a durable product and settings-surface commitment that cannot be inferred from correctness or test coverage.

options.title: Defaults only
options.body: Keep provider-branded celebrations while removing the override storage, validation editor, and Preview-specific settings wiring.

options.title: Defaults plus editor
options.body: Accept persistent local per-provider customization and its ongoing UI, localization, and compatibility maintenance.

recommendation.title: Defaults only
recommendation.body: Keep provider-branded celebrations while removing the override storage, validation editor, and Preview-specific settings wiring.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor explicitly requested this scope decision from the repository owner, who also owns release-level product acceptance.
